name: Wildsense
description: Forest and Swamp hexes silhouette at +2 fog radius; Rest sites within 4 hexes are revealed. (S3)

name: Verdant Passage
description: Forest and Swamp cost 1 step for the party's next 5 steps. Cost reduction, never refund.

name: Beast Envoy
description: Send an animal scout along a drawn path of up to 6 hexes, charting as it goes. (S3 — path targeting)

name: Thornwall
description: Patrols cannot enter the chosen adjacent hex for 8 party steps. (S3 — patrol APIs)
